verdict.rationale: Convex pushes schema changes to an isolated dev deployment via the CLI watcher, and functions can be run against it with `npx convex run`. Deployments can also run locally, and preview deployments are a listed plan feature. The official MCP server lets agents work with a deployment and blocks production access by default, so agent-driven schema work stays off production unless explicitly allowed. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on preview deployments (creation, branch tie-in, promotion to prod), an explicit documented workflow for an agent creating or validating schema migrations in a preview environment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
